paper.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Simulations for Realistic Clinical Interactions
paper.central_claim: 多轮主动诊断模拟中，通过经验记忆检索、CoT和集成，使医生随病例积累渐进提升诊断能力。
paper.scope: A类非权重案例/反思存储；固定材料标题为MedAgentSim前缀，与manifest简标题差异已核对ID/version。

provenance.notes: 按派发配置sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol执行；没有可独立核验的模型回执、session ID或receipt，按模板置null。未运行论文代码，无外部检索，无其他席/批次输出访问。

sections_read: 全文Abstract、§1–4、Tables1–4、Figures1–4图注；末尾HTML辅助文本；无附录段落

evidence.quote: During a new consultation, the system uses k-nearest neighbors (KNN) to retrieve relevant past cases. The Medical Records Buffer provides full conversations and diagnoses, while the Experience Records Buffer extracts key insights from the reflection process.
evidence.support_explanation: 两个非权重缓冲区在后续咨询检索使用。

evidence.quote: If the revised diagnosis is correct, only the CLIP-embedded reflection insights are stored in the Experience Records Buffer; otherwise, the case is discarded to ensure learning is based on meaningful examples.
evidence.support_explanation: 正确性门控及失败丢弃；不等于正确性判断无误。

evidence.quote:
Model accuracy is evaluated using a
binary true/false metric
for the final diagnosis, with an LLM serving as the evaluator to account for variability in generated responses. Both the dataset conversion process and accuracy logs were manually reviewed to ensure reliability.
evidence.support_explanation: 诊断指标和人工复核，但无评估器错误率。

evidence.quote: For VLM tasks, we utilized the NEJM dataset, which includes 15 complex real-world cases along with an extended set, NEJM Extended, of 120 additional cases. MedQA comprises 106 simulated diagnostic scenarios, while its extended variant, MedQA Extended, contains 214 distinct cases. Additionally, MIMIC-IV features 288 clinical cases, providing a diverse set of real-world medical interactions.
evidence.support_explanation: 五组样本规模已给出；未给记忆构建/测试隔离。

evidence.quote: In MedQA, it achieves 70.8% with LLaMA 3.3, while the best-performing baseline model records 62.3%. Similarly, in MedQA Extended, MedAgentSim attains 72.0%, a notable increase over the 63.6% baseline.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者跨基座最优比较不是同模型记忆贡献；Table1同基座54.7→70.8。
增量记忆对照LLaMA59.4→65.1；51.9属另一列，按表头核对。

evidence.quote:
incorporated memory-replay techniques to enhance agent performance. However, these approaches deviate from real-world clinical practice, as doctor agents are provided with
a pre-compiled, complete medical report of the patient
evidence.support_explanation: 作者将前沿残余定位为主动信息获取而不是首次使用记忆。

evidence.quote: on a 4×48 GB NVIDIA RTX A6000 setup.
evidence.support_explanation: 给硬件，未给累计调用、检索/反思开销。
仅两医生四视频的行为现实性探查，不是临床有效性。
